payment_method.source: dwh.fact_scrooge_payments (latest attempt per transaction, service_reference_id = transaction_code, window 2026-08-27..09-02 Jakarta, k>=25) joined to the journey's monetization fact; pulled read-only via de-central 2026-09-04. entered = transactions that ATTEMPTED a payment with this method; converted = confirmed. Transactions with no payment attempt are excluded here (see payment_funnel), so rates are not tautological with confirmation.

payment_funnel.source: dwh.fact_scrooge_payments (latest attempt per transaction, service_reference_id = transaction_code, window 2026-08-27..09-02 Jakarta, k>=25) joined to the journey's monetization fact; pulled read-only via de-central 2026-09-04. Distribution of created transactions across the payment step: never reached payment (no scrooge attempt and not confirmed), no payment needed (free / insurance-covered), confirmed without a payment record (COD and other non-scrooge flows), and attempted-by-outcome. Distribution only: a segment here is defined by the outcome, so no conversion rate is meaningful.
